prompt: Who was the president of the USA when the wife of the former HEB Grocery Company CEO Howard Edward Butt Sr. died?
answer: Bill Clinton was president of the United States when Mary Elizabeth Holdsworth Butt, Howard Edward Butt Sr.’s wife, died on October 6, 1993.
